metadata.description: Tom Panos's Claude skills and plugins for insurance performance marketing, GOAL Platform account management, and B2B research.

plugins.name: campaign-analyst
plugins.description: Diagnose GOAL Platform campaign performance, right-price sources from RightPricing data, and build client-facing account review reports.

plugins.name: goal-disposition-import
plugins.description: Transform raw CRM disposition exports into GOAL-ready CSV files for Conversion Bulk Import.

plugins.name: research-company
plugins.description: B2B company research that produces a professionally formatted PDF account report from a company URL.

plugins.name: account-ops-notion
plugins.description: Notion-based account management: the weekday Daily Account Brief, per-account Recent Updates callouts, and review-meeting recap notes with tasks. Personalize with config/profile.yaml.

plugins.name: market-research-reports
plugins.description: Consulting-style market research reports (TAM/SAM/SOM, competitive landscape, Porter's Five Forces, PESTLE, SWOT) compiled to PDF with LaTeX and sourced charts.

plugins.name: prompt-engineering-expert
plugins.description: Write, review, and debug prompts for Claude (system prompts, agent prompts, CLAUDE.md files) using Anthropic's current best practices, with model-specific tuning.
